missions.title: The Birds
missions.description: "At the end of the garden, the statue of the golden goddess glares at the flying bird."

missions.title: Luxury, Peace, and Pleasure
missions.description: "Under the leadership of old friends, Erma returns to the long-lost garden."

missions.title: The Open Window
missions.description: "Under the brilliant palace lies a secret buried by his majesty."

missions.title: Harmony in Red
missions.description: "That which the Fox Sisters lost became the guiding wind for Erma's new journey."

missions.title: The Broken Vase
missions.description: "We always keep looking back at the past. Only by facing the abyss of the past can time continue to move forward."

missions.title: The Cradle
missions.description: "We are born from a mother's cradle, and shall return to one at our end."

missions.title: Artificial Paradises
missions.description: "That which we define as heaven is simply an imaginary construct of our human mind. Heaven changes according to what you are willing to believe it to be."

missions.title: The Lamp
missions.description: "Here, the stones are lonely. Oh you, broad and melancholic soul, trod a night without end, a dawn to never rend."

missions.title: Words in Stone
missions.description: "They know our eternal desires, they meld the darkness inside all of us with so much fire."

missions.title: I Live, I Die
missions.description: "And see thy blood warm when thou feel'st it cold."

missions.title: Portrait of a Bird
missions.description: "The bird sends its first letter to a distant land."

missions.title: The King and the Bird
missions.description: "A fairy tale arrives in the hands of Lyudmila."

missions.title: Dance of the Nymphs
missions.description: "Regardless of whether she was successful or if she went through much trouble, Lyudmila has been caught in a whirlpool of confusion."

missions.title: The Card Players
missions.description: "Lyudmila has always been worried about being clueless, only to find out that she was the one most familiar with the rules of the game at the table."

missions.title: The Bird Among Ruins
missions.description: "Among ruins is a bird freed from death, a nest among gray stones under the sun's breath. Beyond sorrow, beyond memory; it knows there is no tomorrow in eternity."

missions.title: After the Fire
missions.description: "Here, the symbol has collapsed. Here, it is almost dawn."
